Method of Attack: Encrypting servers responsible for healthcare services including electronic health records, diagnostics, imaging, and intranet services
Manually deployed ransomware targeting specific files for encryption
No ransom note dropped on encrypted systems
Impacted Systems: Healthcare and Public Health (HPH) Sector organizations across the U.S.
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of compromise (IOCs) obtained by FBI during response to Maui ransomware attacks since May 2021
